_noTransactionDataComment: true: this instance reads no operator key file and serves no unsigned calldata (/api/approval, /api/v4-approval, /api/sell/quote, /api/mint/* answer 403) and the Wallet page hides the operator approvals, Sell and Mint tabs. Defaults to true for chain 8453 and 369 (PulseChain: set it explicitly in its settings.json too) and false elsewhere: LP_READONLY alone does not imply it.
_comment: Base (8453): the SERVER is read-only: Aerodrome Slipstream (two position managers) plus Uniswap v3/v4. Copy to $HOME/base-data/settings.json (or LP_BASE_DATA_DIR). No collector, vault, risk.autoCollect or risk.sell sections: the server cannot sign. The only signing is collector-base.js, run by run-collector.sh, and only for wallets with collect:true whose owner approved the operator (see baseCollect below and README: Auto-collect on Base). Secrets are NEVER written here: a keyed RPC goes in the environment as LP_BASE_RPC_URL, a Blockscout PRO key as BLOCKSCOUT_API_KEY (both from .env). Every address below is proven by: node tools/verify-onchain.js base

chain.name: Base
chain._rpcUrlComment: Public. mainnet.base.org answers eth_call but refuses every eth_getLogs (HTTP 429), so logs go to logsRpcUrl. Set LP_BASE_RPC_URL in the environment to use a keyed endpoint instead; it overrides this one in that process only and is never shown to a page or logged.
chain._logsRpcUrlComment: Public, used only for eth_getLogs: allows 50,000-block ranges but only recent history, so pinned tokenIds remain the primary way to find a staked position.
chain._blockscoutComment: Cloudflare answers scripts with an HTML 403, and api.blockscout.com/8453 answers 402 without a key: both are treated as unavailable and the RPC discovery covers it. With BLOCKSCOUT_API_KEY set, requests go to api.blockscout.com/8453.

wallets._comment: main: Trading, the wallet that holds the Aerodrome positions. watched: shown read-only. collect (main and watched): false ships everywhere. true lets collector-base.js (run by run-collector.sh) collect that wallet's fees on Base, to the wallet itself, but ONLY after the wallet approved the operator with setApprovalForAll on each position manager (README: Auto-collect on Base, including the risk). Nothing else changes. v4Ids: Uniswap v4 token ids pinned for this wallet, verified with ownerOf on every refresh; use when position discovery is incomplete (Blockscout refused, log scan slow).

tokens._comment: The key USDG is legacy: it is the USD reference stable, here Base USDC (6 decimals). usdReferenceFeeTier 3000: the deepest WETH/USDC pool on Base is Uniswap v3 fee 3000 (42M USDC), not 500.

contracts._comment: positionManager/factory/v4: Uniswap v3 and v4 on Base. slipstream: Aerodrome Slipstream. THREE Aerodrome managers exist and all answer name() 'Slipstream Position NFT v1', so they are told apart by address and by the name given here (which prefixes the token id). The middle 'Gauge Caps' manager 0xa990C6a7...D55F holds none of the positions and is not configured. poolFactory: Aerodrome's classic pool factory, used for the AERO price. tokenIds: positions pinned so a staked one is found without Blockscout. fromBlock: the manager's deploy block, where the log scan stops. scan: false switches the eth_getLogs discovery scan off (pins + the gauges of held pools cover the known ids, and the log RPC cannot reach back that far). To enable it, set scan: true (or remove the key: it then runs only while Blockscout is unavailable) AND set fromBlock to a block inside the log RPC's history (public RPCs keep days to weeks, not years), and scanRange to the widest range that RPC answers (default 2000000, set it to chain.maxLogRange or less for a public RPC).

baseCollect._comment: Limits of the daily Base collect pass (collector-base.js); every key is optional, these are the defaults. A position is collected only when its fees are at least minFeesUsd AND at least minFeesToGasRatio times the gas cost. maxGasPerRunEth caps what one run may spend, maxGasPriceGwei is a HARD CAP on the SIGNED maxFeePerGas (the pass computes the fee itself from the block base fee and refuses when base fee + tip exceed it), maxPriorityFeeGwei caps the tip, maxGasLimit is an absolute ceiling on one collect (a larger estimate is skipped), maxGasPerTxEth caps one transaction at its worst case (gasLimit x maxFeePerGas + 2 x the L1 fee quote), maxCollectsPerRun caps the transactions, dailyGasCapEth caps the trailing 24 hours (reservations of unconfirmed transactions included), waitTimeoutSec is how long one transaction may stay unconfirmed before the run stops, minL1AllowanceEth is the floor of the L1 data-fee allowance (allowance = max(2 x oracle quote, this floor); the L1 part is an estimate, not a hard bound).

baseSweep._comment: The Base sweep (collector-base-sweep.js, README: Sweep on Base). OFF: only the boolean true enables it, and only after node collector-base.js --init-state created sweep-state.json. When on, the fees are collected to the OPERATOR, every WETH / cbBTC / LAPTOP fee is swapped to native Base USDC through the fixed Uniswap v3 SwapRouter02 pools (addresses are compiled into the code, nothing here can add one), and 100% is delivered to the NFT's on-chain owner. Every number is optional, out-of-range values are clamped to the hard bounds in the code. routes.<WETH|cbBTC|LAPTOP>.enabled may only be set to false. vault: the split to a token-bound vault stays 0 until tba is set AND verified on chain at run time (node tools/verify-base-sweep.js); there is no Base vault yet, so tba is null.
